<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Admins change these on **Admin → Config** while the server runs. A setting set by its environment variable, or in the config file under its key, cannot be changed there: the variable, then the file, wins. How they fit together is in [Configuration](/docs/self-hosting/configuration/).

## Accounts

### Registration

Who may create an account: anyone (open), people an admin invited (invite), or only admins, on the Users page (closed).

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.registration` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_REGISTRATION` |
| Kind | one of `open`, `invite`, `closed` |
| Default | `invite` |
| Applies | at once |

### Verify sign-ups

People who sign up themselves get a link by mail, and can sign in once they open it; an account unverified after 7 days is removed. Needs mail set up, under Mail. Accounts from before, and those admins create, count as verified.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.verify_email` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_VERIFY_EMAIL` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### Password reset by email

Forgot password? on the sign-in page mails a link to set a new one, working once for an hour; setting it signs the account out everywhere. Works while mail is set up, under Mail.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.password_reset` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

### Idle sign-out

A browser session unused this long signs out. Applies to new activity at once.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.session_idle_ttl` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_SESSION_IDLE_TTL` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `168h` |
| Applies | at once |

### Longest session

A browser session signs out after this long however active it is. Applies to sessions started from now.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.session_absolute_ttl` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TTL` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `720h` |
| Applies | at once |

### Invite lifetime

How long an invite works. Applies to invites created from now.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.invite_ttl` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_INVITE_TTL` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `168h` |
| Applies | at once |

### Invites by email

Admins can type an address on the Invites page, and the invite is mailed, naming them; only that address signs up with it, once, verified. Invites can still be shared as links. Works while mail is set up, under Mail.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.invite_email` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_INVITE_EMAIL` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

### Requests to join

While registration is by invite, the sign-up page lets people without one ask for it, with a note. They confirm their address by a mailed link first; admins then approve on the Invites page, which mails an invite there, or deny. Needs mail set up, under Mail.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.requests` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_REQUESTS` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### Tell denied requests

Mail someone whose request to join an admin denied, saying they may ask again in 30 days. Off, a denied request just closes.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.request_denied_mail` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_REQUEST_DENIED_MAIL` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

### Shortest password

The fewest characters a new password may have. Existing passwords keep working.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `auth.min_password_length` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AUTH_MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `12` |
| Applies | at once |

## Workflows

### Workflows per user

The most workflows one user may have. Users above it keep theirs but cannot create more.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `workflows.max_per_user` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_WORKFLOWS_MAX_PER_USER` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `100` |
| Applies | at once |

### Active workflows per user

The most workflows one user may have running. Lowering it stops none; it applies when one is turned on.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `workflows.max_active_per_user` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_WORKFLOWS_MAX_ACTIVE_PER_USER` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `20` |
| Applies | at once |

### Nodes per workflow

The most nodes a workflow may have. Applies when a workflow is saved.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `workflows.max_nodes` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_WORKFLOWS_MAX_NODES` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `200` |
| Applies | at once |

### Fastest schedule

The shortest interval a schedule or market trigger may use, to spare the APIs workflows call.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `workflows.schedule_min_interval` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_WORKFLOWS_SCHEDULE_MIN_INTERVAL` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `1s` |
| Applies | after a restart |

### Tokens per market trigger

The most outcome tokens one market trigger may watch.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `workflows.feed_max_tokens` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_WORKFLOWS_FEED_MAX_TOKENS` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `100` |
| Applies | after a restart |

## Executions

### Keep executions for

Finished executions older than this are deleted, at start and then daily.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `executions.retention` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_EXECUTION_RETENTION` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `720h` |
| Applies | at once |

### Waiting executions per user

The most executions of one user that may wait at once, such as at a Wait node. Past it, a node that would wait fails.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `executions.max_waiting_per_user` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_EXECUTIONS_MAX_WAITING_PER_USER` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `50` |
| Applies | at once |

### Longest wait

How far ahead a wait may end. A node asking to wait longer fails.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `executions.max_wait` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_EXECUTIONS_MAX_WAIT` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `168h` |
| Applies | at once |

## Code

### Who may write code

Code nodes run TypeScript users write: everyone may (everyone), admins and the users switched on for code on the Users page (chosen), or no one, admins included (off). Expressions are not code. A workflow with code nodes whose owner may not write code cannot be saved, and fails at once when it is triggered.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.access` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_ACCESS` |
| Kind | one of `everyone`, `chosen`, `off` |
| Default | `everyone` |
| Applies | at once |

### Custom nodes per user

The most custom nodes one user may define. Users above it keep theirs but cannot make more.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.custom_nodes_per_user` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_CUSTOM_NODES_PER_USER` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `50` |
| Applies | at once |

### Memory per run (MiB)

The most memory one run of user code may use. Running out stops the run.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.memory` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_MEMORY` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `64` |
| Applies | at once |

### Time per run

How long one run of user code may take, waiting for the data it asks for included.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.time` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_TIME` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `5s` |
| Applies | at once |

### Result per run (KiB)

The largest result one run of user code may return, measured as JSON.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.output` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_OUTPUT` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `1024` |
| Applies | at once |

### Data requests per run

How many times one run of user code, or of a plugin's node, may ask Polythought for data or anything else, such as a market search or a fetch. A plugin's trigger may ask as often each minute.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.host_calls` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_HOST_CALLS` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `100` |
| Applies | at once |

### Runs at once

How many runs of user code may go at the same time; the others wait their turn. 0 means one per CPU of the server.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.concurrency` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_CONCURRENCY` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `0` |
| Applies | after a restart |

### Runner processes

Whether user code runs in processes of its own, one for each run at once, rather than in the server's: for public instances. A runner reaches nothing but the server, and runs in the sandbox where the server has one, on Linux 6.2 or later. Each takes about 80 MiB, more while it runs. Off, code runs in the server's process, inside its engine and its limits all the same.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `code.runners` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_CODE_RUNNERS` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | after a restart |

## Plugins

### Plugins directory

Where installed plugins are kept: a directory the server may write, a volume in Docker. What admins decide about them is kept in the database.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.dir` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_DIR` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | `plugins` |
| Applies | after a restart |

### Trusted signing keys

minisign public keys whose signatures you trust, one a line: the key's line from its .pub file, after a name and a space if you like, such as "Polythought RWQf6LRC…". A plugin they signed shows who did; any other installs only after a warning.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.trusted_keys` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_KEYS` |
| Kind | list; in the environment, separated by commas |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Largest archive (MB)

The largest plugin archive an admin may install, uploaded or fetched.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.max_archive` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_MAX_ARCHIVE` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `100` |
| Applies | at once |

### Plugin fetch time

How long a plugin's request to another site may take, from connecting to its answer's last byte.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.fetch_time` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_FETCH_TIME` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `10s` |
| Applies | at once |

### Plugin fetch size (KiB)

The largest body a plugin's request to another site may send, and its answer bring back.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.fetch_body` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_FETCH_BODY` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `1024` |
| Applies | at once |

### Plugin store per node (KiB)

How much one plugin node may keep in its store, its keys and values, in each workflow. Writes past it are refused; what is kept already stays.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.store_size` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_STORE_SIZE` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `1024` |
| Applies | at once |

### Unsandboxed plugins

Whether plugins start without the sandbox where the server has none: not on Linux, or on a kernel older than 6.2. Unsandboxed, a plugin reaches whatever the server can, its files, its network and its other processes, so allow it only for plugins you would run yourself. Off, they do not start there. Where the server has a sandbox, plugins always run in it. From each plugin's next start.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.unsandboxed` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_UNSANDBOXED` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### Plugin data cap (MiB)

How much disk one plugin may take, its own directory and its temporary one together. Past it, the plugin is stopped as crashed and the admins told. Its card on the Plugins page may set its own.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.data_cap` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_DATA_CAP` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `1024` |
| Applies | at once |

### Plugin memory cap (MiB)

How much memory one plugin's process may take. Past it, the process is killed, which counts as a crash, and started again; a plugin written in Go also gets a soft limit a little under it, from its next start. Watched on Linux. Its card on the Plugins page may set its own.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `plugins.memory_cap` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_PLUGINS_MEMORY_CAP` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `256` |
| Applies | at once |

## Trading

### Paper balance ($)

What a workflow's paper account starts with, in dollars: its paper buys spend it and its sells add to it. Accounts already open keep theirs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.paper_balance` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_PAPER_BALANCE` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `1000` |
| Applies | at once |

### Live trading

Whether workflows may trade live: real orders on Polymarket from their owner's wallet, spending its pUSD. Off, every workflow trades on paper and live orders are refused. On, an owner switches a workflow to live in its Trading view, confirming it. Turning it off cancels every live order resting on the book, every user's; workflows switched to live stay so, but place no orders until it is on again.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.live` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_LIVE` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### Max $ a live order

The most one live buy may spend, in whole dollars, for every user: one over it is refused before it is sent. 0 for no cap. An admin can give a user a cap of their own on the Users page.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.max_live_order` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_MAX_LIVE_ORDER` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `100` |
| Applies | at once |

### Max $ a day of live buys

The most a user's live buys may spend and hold in 24 hours, in whole dollars, all their workflows together: what they spent, and what their resting buys may still spend. A buy that would go over is refused before it is sent. 0 for no cap. An admin can give a user a cap of their own on the Users page.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.max_live_day` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_MAX_LIVE_DAY` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `1000` |
| Applies | at once |

### Builder code

Your Polymarket builder code, 0x and 64 hex digits, from polymarket.com/settings?tab=builder: live orders then carry it, crediting your builder account with their volume, and pay the builder fee you set there on top of Polymarket's. Empty, orders carry none and pay no builder fee.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.builder_code` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_BUILDER_CODE` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Private keys

Whether users may import a wallet's private key, so it can trade: on, off, or auto, on unless anyone may sign up (Registration open). The server keeps imported keys encrypted, and could trade with them. Keys imported before stay when it is switched off; new ones are refused.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.key_import` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_KEY_IMPORT` |
| Kind | one of `auto`, `on`, `off` |
| Default | `auto` |
| Applies | at once |

### Builder API key

Your Polymarket Builder API key, with its secret and passphrase below, from polymarket.com/settings?tab=builder. Users of Deposit Wallets can authorise session keys once all three are in: trade-only keys that need no private key here. Polymarket must enable the key for session keys first (builder@polymarket.com).

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.builder_api_key` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_BUILDER_API_KEY` |
| Kind | text, secret: stored encrypted and never shown |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Builder secret

The secret of the Builder API key, base64.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.builder_secret` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_BUILDER_SECRET` |
| Kind | text, secret: stored encrypted and never shown |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Builder passphrase

The passphrase of the Builder API key.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.builder_passphrase` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_BUILDER_PASSPHRASE` |
| Kind | text, secret: stored encrypted and never shown |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Polygon RPC

The Polygon JSON-RPC endpoint the server reads approvals from before it grants any, and estimates proxy wallets' gas with: https://polygon.drpc.org, the one Polymarket's client uses, unless you set another, such as your own node or a provider's URL. Kept secret, as such URLs often hold a key.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `trading.polygon_rpc` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRADING_POLYGON_RPC` |
| Kind | text, secret: stored encrypted and never shown |
| Default | `https://polygon.drpc.org` |
| Applies | at once |

## AI agents

### Max $ a month of agent spend

The most a user's AI agent nodes may spend in a calendar month, UTC, in dollars to the cent, all their workflows together: counted as providers report what they charged, which OpenRouter does and the others do not, so their calls count against the token caps only. Polythought keeps no prices. Once reached, the next call is refused. 0 for no cap. An admin can give a user caps of their own on the Users page.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `agents.max_dollars_month` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AGENTS_MAX_DOLLARS_MONTH` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | `20.00` |
| Applies | at once |

### Max input tokens a month

The most input tokens a user's AI agent nodes may take in a calendar month, UTC, all their workflows together: what they read, prompts and tool results. A call that could go over is refused before it is made. 0 for no cap.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `agents.max_input_month` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AGENTS_MAX_INPUT_MONTH` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `0` |
| Applies | at once |

### Max output tokens a month

The most output tokens a user's AI agent nodes may take in a calendar month, UTC: what the models write, thinking included. A call that could go over, its Max tokens with it, is refused before it is made. 0 for no cap.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `agents.max_output_month` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AGENTS_MAX_OUTPUT_MONTH` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `0` |
| Applies | at once |

### Max tokens a month

The most tokens a user's AI agent nodes may take in a calendar month, UTC, input and output together. A call that could go over is refused before it is made. 0 for no cap.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `agents.max_total_month` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_AGENTS_MAX_TOTAL_MONTH` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `20000000` |
| Applies | at once |

## Agents over MCP

### Agents over MCP

Let users connect agents such as Claude Code and Codex: an agent signs in through its user's browser, where they allow it scopes, then works at /mcp. Off, /mcp and agents' sign-in are not there, and agents already connected stop until it is on again; their grants stay, to revoke on Settings.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.enabled` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_ENABLED` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

### Agents register themselves

Let an agent with no metadata document of its own register itself, naming itself, as older agents do; the consent page marks it unverified. Off, only agents whose metadata document is at an https address can sign in. Agents registered before keep working.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.registration` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_REGISTRATION` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

### Documents at private addresses

Fetch agents' metadata documents from addresses inside the server's network too, for an agent published there. Leave off on a shared instance: any signed-in user could have the server fetch one. Agents on a private network can register themselves instead.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.private_documents` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_PRIVATE_DOCUMENTS` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### Let allowed agents through

An agent asking for no more than its user allowed it before gets in without the consent page asking again, as when it starts on another of their machines. Off, the page asks every time.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.skip_consent` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_SKIP_CONSENT` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

### Tool calls a minute

How many tool calls one agent, or one API token, may make in a minute, all at once if they come so; past it, a call is refused until the minute allows another. A change applies at once.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.rate` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_RATE` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `120` |
| Applies | at once |

### Access token lifetime

How long an agent's access token works before it refreshes it. Revoking an agent stops it at once whatever this is. Applies to tokens given from now.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.access_ttl` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_ACCESS_TTL` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `1h` |
| Applies | at once |

### Refresh token lifetime

How long an agent may go unused before its user signs it in again: each refresh gives it a new refresh token, lasting this long. Applies to tokens given from now.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.refresh_ttl` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_REFRESH_TTL` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `720h` |
| Applies | at once |

### Live actions wait

How long an agent's or an API token's live action waits for its user to confirm it, where the user has it wait, before it expires unconfirmed. Applies to those asked from now.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mcp.confirm_for` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MCP_CONFIRM_FOR` |
| Kind | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `168h` |
| Default | `1h` |
| Applies | at once |

## Network

### Trusted proxies

Address ranges (CIDR, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8) of reverse proxies allowed to report the client's address in X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty without a proxy: anyone could then pick their own address and dodge rate limits.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `http.trusted_proxies` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TRUSTED_PROXIES` |
| Kind | list; in the environment, separated by commas |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Private addresses

Let workflows reach addresses inside the server's network, such as a service on the same machine: webhooks, and language models served there through an OpenAI-compatible key, in plain http too (never to a public address). Leave off on a shared instance.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `webhook.allow_private` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### GitHub stars

Ask GitHub about once an hour how many stars Polythought's repository has, to show beside its link in the app and the docs. Off, the server never calls GitHub, and the link shows no count.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `github.stars` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_GITHUB_STARS` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `true` |
| Applies | at once |

## Logging

### Log level

The least severe messages the server logs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `log.level` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_LOG_LEVEL` |
| Kind | one of `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error` |
| Default | `info` |
| Applies | at once |

### Log format

Plain text for people, JSON for log collectors.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `log.format` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_LOG_FORMAT` |
| Kind | one of `text`, `json` |
| Default | `text` |
| Applies | after a restart |

## Telegram

### Telegram bot

Run the instance's Telegram bot, so members can link Telegram from Settings. Changes restart the bot, not the server.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `telegram.enabled` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TELEGRAM_ENABLED` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |

### Bot token

The token @BotFather gave you when you made the bot, like 123456:ABC-DEF…

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `telegram.token` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN` |
| Kind | text, secret: stored encrypted and never shown |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### How the bot gets messages

polling asks Telegram for new messages, and works anywhere, even behind a firewall. webhook has Telegram send them to this server, and needs the public URL to be https.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `telegram.mode` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_TELEGRAM_MODE` |
| Kind | one of `polling`, `webhook` |
| Default | `polling` |
| Applies | at once |

## Mail

### Mail server

The SMTP server Polythought sends mail through, like mail.example.com, with no port: that is below. Mail is set up once this and the From address are in.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.host` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_HOST` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Port

587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS from the start, 25 for a plain connection.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.port` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_PORT` |
| Kind | whole number |
| Default | `587` |
| Applies | at once |

### Security

starttls upgrades the connection to TLS, tls uses TLS from the start, none stays plain, for a server on the same host or network. The server's certificate is always checked; a password is never sent over a plain connection, except to this host.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.security` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_SECURITY` |
| Kind | one of `starttls`, `tls`, `none` |
| Default | `starttls` |
| Applies | at once |

### Username

The account Polythought signs in to the mail server with. Leave empty for a server that takes mail without signing in.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.username` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_USERNAME` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### Password

The password of that account.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.password` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_PASSWORD` |
| Kind | text, secret: stored encrypted and never shown |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### From address

The address Polythought's mail comes from, like polythought@example.com. Your mail server must let the account send as it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.from_address` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | empty |
| Applies | at once |

### From name

The name mail comes from, shown beside the address.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.from_name` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_FROM_NAME` |
| Kind | text |
| Default | `Polythought` |
| Applies | at once |

### Notifications by email

Users may get their notifications by email too: each chooses per kind in Settings, by email off until they turn it on. Works while mail is set up.

| | |
|---|---|
| Key | `mail.notifications` |
| Environment variable | `POLYTHOUGHT_MAIL_NOTIFICATIONS` |
| Kind | `true` or `false` |
| Default | `false` |
| Applies | at once |
